observations.body: Paul recounts a later Jerusalem meeting in which James, Cephas, and John recognize grace and extend fellowship across distinct missions.
observations.label: Cephas among the pillars

observations.body: The passage presents Recognition and division of mission as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Recognition and division of mission

observations.body: The passage places Cephas named among pillars beside Recognition and division of mission.
observations.label: Cephas named among pillars

payload.posture: Read Galatians 2:1–10 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul recounts a later Jerusalem meeting in which James, Cephas, and John recognize grace and extend fellowship across distinct missions. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: Cephas among the pillars
